LineI supports optional tolerance: d/dx(f(x),a,tol) and integral(f(x),a,b,tol). Negative and zero tolerance produce Argument ERROR. Integral tolerance 0.1, 1 and 1e-22 are accepted in the measured polynomial cases.

Independent derivative displays with tolerance 1e-22: sin at 1 radian, x^3 at 2, ln at 3 and exp at 1. Abs(x^2-3x+2) at 1 times out. This does not establish internal 22-digit equivalence for arbitrary functions.

Equation coefficient draft survives Argument ERROR and Back; replacing negative tolerance with 0.00001 commits 136/3. The wrapped ordinary LineI expression and scrolling coefficient footer have separate measured layouts.
Non-polynomial integral 1/x on [1,2] with explicit tolerance 1e-10 displays 0.6931471806. Default tolerance behavior remains covered by existing fixtures.
